scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @hackaton/functions && npm run build --workspace @hackaton/web
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @hackaton/functions && node --experimental-strip-types --test apps/web/tests/prototype.test.ts packages/shared/tests/*.test.ts apps/functions/tests/*.test.ts
scripts.emulators: npm run build --workspace @hackaton/functions && firebase emulators:start --project demo-hackaton --only auth,firestore,storage,functions
